'''Woodruff''' (Japanese: '''モリオ''' ''Morio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP119|A Sappy Ending]]''. He is the first character of the day to appear in {{aniseries|GS}}.

Woodruff is a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger|ranger}} for the Forest and Wildlife Bureau, who works in an area close to [[Violet City]]. He told {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that he was free to catch as many {{p|Heracross}} as he wanted, but warned that he might unintentionally disturb the balance of nature. Woodruff described a case of {{wp|commensalism}} in which the Heracross' strong teeth made the tree sap available for the {{p|Butterfree}} to feed on. {{an|Misty}} noted that the forest was in a terrible condition, which Woodruff explained was the effect of the invading {{p|Pinsir}} that were going unchallenged by the peaceful Heracross.

Woodruff guided the group to the area of the forest where the Pinsir lived, suspecting something may have been amiss with the Pinsir. All signs, including a destroyed rope bridge and a [[Team Rocket's mechas|Pinsir mecha]], pointed to human intervention, and he soon spotted the culprits, {{TRT}}. He assisted the group and Heracross in defeating Team Rocket, and the Pinsir immediately returned to their side of the forest.
